_comment: WP-0314 (Open World Streaming Research gaps 4 and 5). Computed rules, not hand-set numbers: (1) which collider meshes are baked ahead with Physics.BakeMesh in a job (a mesh collider reuses the bake only when cooking options match exactly, scale is not skewed or negative and the mesh is unchanged); (2) the async upload buffer is sized from the largest upload of the region (mesh or texture), times headroom, rounded up to round_mb, clamped to the tier range. Today the project sets 16 MB persistent and a 2 ms slice without checking the largest cell asset. cook_ms_per_ktri is the proposed synchronous cook cost on the Honor X5b class (unmeasured) so the report can show first-activation cost. Proposals until the device streaming report.
